api_review.classification: Public signatures/layouts unchanged. Receive supplies static evidence for NUL-containing Subscription-Id-Data with no extra group children, retaining ErrField and path443/444. The consumer resolves the first failing repeated group in original order. Build/Send, mixed extras, structural/wire order and later request type-pairing/relations retain their behavior.
api_review.version_choice: Combined slice.27; next core/adapter candidate v0.2.0-rc.2 planned and unpublished. No tags or module requirements changed.
api_review.migration: Regenerate external bindings; preserve original builds for earlier Bundle fingerprints and never relabel records.

assertions: Receive data evidence requires NUL and no extra group children; ErrField and path443/444 remain, with no ErrUnsupported added. Build/Send stay unchanged.
The complete root scan retains at most two vendor-zero group443 views in a fixed array and enforces MaxRepeated. Root and visited descendants share one source counter.

Visit groups in wire order. Earlier groups must be closed, structurally valid and NUL-free; select the first closed NUL-containing group. Later group payloads remain opaque after the trusted decoder stopped at that failure.
Each visited group has one correctly flagged four-byte type450 and one data444. Type values remain unrestricted at this group callback; type0/type1 pairing remains a later request rule.
Owned16+align4(n)-byte quotes contain a minimal group header and the complete original padded selected data, with no type or other subscription data. Padding does not participate in the NUL check.
Both instances, simultaneous failures, reordered groups, earlier/selected/later malformed groups, signed types, source ownership and exact/one-less budgets are covered.

TCP/TLS ordinary and emergency acceptance covers IEC, INITIAL, TERMINATION, direct debit, balance and refund, with exact envelopes, non-delivery, held charges, valid follow-up, short-budget closure and retirement.
Existing equipment/address tests now assert an earlier subscription-data diagnostic rather than bypassing it or quoting a later error.

Full pure/race and twenty-round selected regression use fixed inputs; one affected million-execution fuzz target runs locally and all17 run in hosted CI. Initial input-stability gate failure is retained separately.
Pure Go, application-owned persistence, module requirements, immutable tags, frozen rc.1 receipts and all24 completion conditions remain unchanged.
remaining: Other existing conditional/value rules (including request relations, MMS field exclusions and SMS C-string constraints), mixed values/omissions and unreviewed group/cardinality/domain/handshake/header mappings remain separate. Keep safe close when no reviewed diagnostic applies.
The changed development checkout needs a future immutable version and fresh core/adapter/cold-install acceptance. The verified rc.1 receipt remains valid only for its frozen commits.
External private-template/target-recovery/role evidence and declared long-soak/saturation/tenant/mixed-transport acceptance remain separate.

initial_failures.resolution: Core and adapter tests passed, but the input-stability gate detected the concurrently refreshed API snapshot/support matrix. Kept the receipt and reran the pure suite after API generation completed. No production or test change was needed.

One existing TestPublicBindingRecoveryMatrix/legacy420/refund/restart/5012 case returned ErrRoRecoveryImport. No affected production code in that binding changed. The exact case passed100 repetitions each in pure/race; full race passed, and full pure was rerun with fixed inputs. Root cause was not established; retain this observation rather than claim a fix.

verification_observations: A single existing legacy420 refund restart import refusal was not reproduced in100 pure and100 race repetitions. Its cause remains unconfirmed; no recovery authorization or clock check was weakened.
